method.exactCriticalEvents: Every original vertex y and segment-intersection y, including all body/head edges.
method.openSlabs: Midpoints select constant edge/winding order only. Every adjacent affine endpoint order and merge inequality is proved at both slab boundaries, hence throughout the entire open slab.
method.criticalLines: Exact closed-source horizontal intersections, merged across original polygons; every line is a single closed interval and equals both adjacent affine limits.
method.simpleOriginalPolygons: Every nonadjacent edge pair checked for any exact intersection, with nonzero signed area.
method.prefixConclusion: Original P union intersect y<=h has a continuous single interval at each occupied y, so every nonempty prefix is connected. No phase clock is inferred.
method.priorContact: Exact strip margins in original body and prior V terminal diamond; source prior must later be verified complete and opaque in actual component.
method.boundaryContact: Body/head meet along their original vertical edge only. Positive-area overlap is false, not silently treated as true.

scope: Geometry-only possible y-prefix family. Not source-Q timing equivalence, a progressive clock choice, anti-alias contact proof, actual component observation or new policy module approval.
